hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE 'src-react/src/generated|src-ts/src/tauri-bindings|scripts/.dist|shared/types/generated|shared/sdk/generated|bridge/generated'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit generated files. Run npm run gen instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi
